summary: Fleet Map / GIS: a new offline geographic + indoor spatial view of the adopted node fleet, rendered with OpenLayers (vendored into the myseliasan frontend, lazy-loaded so it never weighs down the initial bundle) and a self-hosted Protomaps .pmtiles basemap served by a new Range-served handler (GET /api/basemap/info, GET /api/basemap/tiles.pmtiles) - no tile CDN, so it works on an air-gapped/intranet install like the rest of the app. The Geographic view plots nodes at lat/lon (new ManagedNode.Lat/Lon/MapPlaced fields, set by dragging a pin via PUT /api/nodes/{id}/position) and colors each pin online/warning(cert expiring)/critical(lost)/idle, matching the existing Dashboard cert-health signal. The Floor plans view lets an operator create sites and add a floor plan per site either by uploading an image (PNG/JPEG/GIF, up to 24 MiB) or by drawing one from scratch in a new built-in floor designer (rooms/walls/text/pen tools, grid-snap, undo/redo, multi-select, rotate/flip, pan/zoom) whose vector shapes round-trip through a new FloorPlan.Design field so a drawn plan can be reopened and re-edited; an uploaded photo can likewise be annotated later, with its pristine original preserved as a new FloorPlan.BgPath background layer (GET /api/floors/{id}/background) so re-editing never draws over an already-flattened render (POST /api/floors/{id}/image replaces the rendered image + design). Nodes/cameras are dragged onto a plan as NodePlacement rows keyed to pixel position on the plan image, myseliasan's own record with a name snapshot so a marker stays visible even while its node is offline; a camera placement now also carries a Heading/Fov coverage arc (degrees), aimed via on-marker handles and drawn as a translucent wedge on the plan so an operator can see which part of a room a camera actually watches. A new GET /api/node-floorplan/{nodeId} drill-down backs a 'Locate on plan' action from a camera event on the geographic view, jumping straight to the right floor plan with the right marker focused; clicking a camera marker opens a small, draggable, resizable floating live-view window (with PTZ when supported) whose recent events open their recorded snapshot/clip in their own floating window, all toggling small/maximized without restarting the underlying WebRTC stream. New/extended endpoints, all AuthOnly and session-gated the same as every other myseliasan operator route: /api/basemap, /api/sites, /api/floors (incl. POST .../image replace and GET .../background), /api/placements (incl. heading/fov), /api/node-floorplan/{nodeId}, and PUT /api/nodes/{id}/position.
compatibility: Backward compatible and additive; no existing node, notification, or RBAC behavior changes. The basemap archive is provisioned out-of-band (not shipped) - an install with no archive still gets a working map, just without cartography (GET /api/basemap/info reports available:false rather than erroring). ManagedNode gains Lat/Lon/MapPlaced columns defaulting to 0/0/false, so every existing adopted node starts as 'unplaced' and simply does not appear on the geographic view until an operator drags it there. NodePlacement gains Heading/Fov (default 0, no arc) and FloorPlan gains Design/BgPath (default empty) - every existing placement/plan keeps its current appearance until an operator sets a coverage arc or re-edits a plan. All four new columns are added by explicit, idempotent, NULL-backfilling migrations in app.go's Migrations() that run before and independently of the autoMigrate config flag, so an upgrade never 500s on a missing column or breaks row scanning on a NULL left by a bare ADD COLUMN, even with auto-migration turned off. Site/FloorPlan/NodePlacement are new tables created empty on first boot after upgrade; the Floor plans view has nothing to show until an operator creates a site. Floor-plan image encryption (both the rendered image and the new background image) follows the same security.encryptAtRest config and default (on) already governing the fleet CA key and PSK, so no separate opt-in is needed. This is a myseliasan-scoped feature and does not touch mymatasan, myidsan, or myiotsan.
